answers.fact: Adele's theme won the Oscar for Best Original Song.

answers.name: Casino Royale
answers.fact: Daniel Craig's first outing, in 2006.

answers.name: Dr. No

answers.name: From Russia with Love
answers.fact: JFK listed the novel among his favourite books.

answers.name: Thunderball
answers.fact: Its underwater battle won an Oscar for visual effects.

answers.name: Live and Let Die

answers.name: Spectre

answers.name: Quantum of Solace

answers.name: Die Another Day

answers.name: Tomorrow Never Dies
answers.fact: The villain is a media mogul.

answers.name: The World Is Not Enough
answers.fact: In the books, it's the Bond family motto.

answers.name: Diamonds Are Forever
answers.fact: Sean Connery's return after a one-film break.

answers.name: The Man with the Golden Gun
answers.fact: Christopher Lee plays the villain, Scaramanga.

answers.fact: Roger Moore's sixth Bond film.

answers.name: A View to a Kill

answers.name: For Your Eyes Only
answers.fact: Sheena Easton is the only theme singer seen in the opening titles.

answers.fact: Timothy Dalton's first Bond.

answers.name: Licence to Kill
answers.fact: Timothy Dalton's second and last Bond.

answers.name: Never Say Never Again

answers.name: On Her Majesty's Secret Service
answers.fact: George Lazenby's one and only outing as Bond.
